name: Drink Frust
source:
A monster from Dai-Lust.
He delivers the female essence of desire to men,
and the male essence of desire to women.
The incarnation of desire.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/escalayer/echara.html]official site[/url]]
